mutations.name: key rows ignore the caption keep-out line
kills: camera framing key boxes fails a key that dips into the caption band at its sample time

mutations.name: key rows check samples outside the key's window
kills: camera framing key boxes ignores samples outside the key's window

mutations.name: a key past the left edge goes unreported
kills: camera framing key boxes fails a key pushed past the frame's left edge

mutations.name: reveal rows flag samples at or after the cue
kills: camera framing reveals passes a reveal object that stays off-frame until its cue

mutations.name: a partly framed reveal object counts as seen
kills: camera framing reveals passes a reveal object only partly in frame before its cue
